tier_1_compiler_fixtures.label: Compiler Fixture Benchmarks (Static Ground-Truth Corpus)
tier_1_compiler_fixtures.default_in_production: EXCLUDED (scope: production_only filters out benchmark/test fixture paths by default)
tier_1_compiler_fixtures.what_it_proves: 100% deterministic extraction precision and recall on Go (go/types, go.work, vendor), Python AST, and TypeScript AST fixtures, plus checkout-path-invariant package cache fingerprints (TestDoubleRunDeterminism).

tier_2_synthetic_grounding_simulations.label: Synthetic Grounding & Contradiction Simulations (Controlled Fault Injection)
tier_2_synthetic_grounding_simulations.default_in_production: OPT-IN ONLY (never injected into live workspace queries unless explicitly requested)
tier_2_synthetic_grounding_simulations.suite_size: 10/10 OTel runtime contradiction injections + 2 canonical multi-team formula & Crore unit-scaling simulations
tier_2_synthetic_grounding_simulations.what_it_proves: Quarantine of unapproved runtime service edges, deterministic self-repair prompt generation under simulated BLOCK/drift conditions, and human-in-the-loop disambiguation of competing team formulas (0.0-1.0 weights) and 10x unit-scaling bugs (48.00 Cr vs 4.80 Cr).

tier_3_live_ast_and_llm_sessions.label: Live Repository AST, RFC 6962 Ledger & Live LLM/MCP Agent Sessions
tier_3_live_ast_and_llm_sessions.suite_size: 63/63 live MCP protocol checks + 54/54 positive & negative behavioral tool tests
tier_3_live_ast_and_llm_sessions.what_it_proves: Real-time AST symbol & blast-radius resolution on live repositories, tenant/workspace isolation, fail-closed read-only mode (GARUDA_MCP_READ_ONLY=true), cryptographic human approval attestation (GARUDA_MCP_APPROVER), and tamper-evident RFC 6962 SHA-256 receipts.
